aiVerification.summary: Draft is not safe for Ask AI because the changed factor and many measurement/spec groupings are misidentified.
issues: Changed factor wrongly groups dates and V32-G4 instead of old/before-improve vs normal/new frame context.
Baseline/test conditions are inconsistent with cited headers and subgroup keys.
Many specs are propagated to unrelated dimensions, creating false violations.
Outcome tables mix frame, yoke, SMG, final height, and NG-rate data without valid grouping.
Several metric rows appear parsed from headers or counts rather than comparable results.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the final case focus on old/before-improve frame mold versus normal/new frame mold?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor from source headers, likely old V06-K1 stock before improve vs normal/new V09-G4 frame mold.
Keep mold/date/component/grill status as subgroup keys unless proven primary.
Re-extract each table with its own header, spec, unit, and component context.
Remove misparsed metrics and false violation counts caused by wrong spec assignment.
Retain only outcomes directly comparable under the verified changed-factor context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient to support the current grouping.
